Dialogs.Dialog: (Oh, right! Maybe I'll invite her on that Nikko-Kinugawa prize trip...)
Hey, ▲小早川＊▲？
Kobayakawa
What？
Actually, I won another prize trip.
What gives...? Aren't you happy？
I might've said this before, but you're buying these, aren't you？ Obviously.
I'm telling you, I'm not! And it's not Atami this time! It's a 2-day, 1-night 'Adult School Trip to Nikko and Kinugawa Onsen'!!
Huh... Nikko and Kinugawa, huh... Wait. 'Adult School Trip'？
Well, in our case, we're still actual students. But hey, a trip's a trip, right？
Yeah... That might be nice.
Right？ And it's free, too.
Not that part.
Huh？ Then the 'adult' part？
Idiot! The 'school trip' part, obviously.
Huh. That's an unusual part for you to care about, ▲小早川＊▲.
Well, I mean... We can't go on a real school trip together, can we...？
Right. Since we're in different grades and all.
If you got held back a year, that'd be a different story, though.
Don't jinx me like that... Still, in that sense, this is a pretty nice idea, huh？
Yeah... This could really work... Mhm, yeah. Heheheh...
What's that about？
Nothing？ So, so？ When is it？ As long as it's a day off, I'm good whenever.
Uh, we can figure out the exact date later, but...
All right, then. Starting ▲月▲▲日▲, it's our 2-day, 1-night Adult School Trip!
Okay♪
Just so we're clear, the 'adult' part has nothing to do with us, okay？ We're still students.
Ah, I see...
Well... I guess a little bit of 'adult' is okay, though？ Since we'll be alone, and... I am your girlfriend.
Yes!
You're so easy to read...
(All right!! A school trip for just me and ▲小早川＊▲!)
▲小早川＊▲。
Kobayakawa
What？
Actually, I won that raffle again. The 'Nikko-Kinugawa Adult School Trip.'
...Hey.
No, no, no... There's just no way.
I'm telling you, I won it! Well, wanna skip it then？
I didn't say that. ...You're not being scammed, right？ Like some shady seminar. You're an easy target...
You're overthinking it... Anyway, when should we go？
(We can always do our date some other day...)
All right! A 2-day, 1-night 'Adult School Trip' starting ▲月▲▲日▲!
Don't emphasize the 'adult' part. I said just a little bit.
Oh, right. ...Wait, how much is 'a little bit' again？
Come on... You already know... Idiot.
(I get to go on a school trip with ▲小早川＊▲, just the two of us!)
(Oh, right! I won that Nikko-Kinugawa prize trip again. Maybe I'll invite her...)
(My phone... Oh, it's ▲小早川＊▲.)
Yes. Hello？
Kobayakawa
Hello？ It's Rinko.
Yeah, what's up？
You're free, right？
Well, yeah, I'm free.
Do we need to shop for anything？ It's a school trip, after all.
Is that how it works？
Pretty sure it is.
(Might as well go along with it.)
So, what are we buying？
Kobayakawa
You figure that part out. You're the older one.
I had a feeling you'd say that... Okay, for starters...
(Wait a sec... Since it's Kinugawa Onsen, they might have a private bath again...)
▲小早川＊▲, don't you need to buy a swimsuit？
A swimsuit？ At this time of year？
Well, they might have a private bath again, like in Atami, right？
Maybe they do, but why are you assuming we're going in together...
...We're not？
I didn't say that... It's just embarrassing going in together in swimsuits...
...Huh？ You mean without swimsuits？
Idiot! Come on, let's go!
All right! Are we all done shopping？ What'd you buy, ▲小早川＊▲？
Kobayakawa
Potato chips.
Snacks...？ Well, I guess that feels like a school trip.
Well, when you're a seasoned traveler like me, you don't really need to prep anything.
Then why did we even come shopping...
What does it matter, as long as you're all prepared？ I have complete faith in you.
Yeah, yeah...
See you, then. Make sure you pack the night before so you're not rushing that morning, okay？
Yeah, yeah. I'll see what I can do! Later, bye-bye!
(She's totally not going to...)
(Yaawn... So sleepy... Let's see, where's ▲小早川＊▲...)
(Not here yet... Well, figures.)
(Hey, come on... This is getting past the point of being funny...)
Kobayakawa
Sorry.
Oh, ▲小早川＊▲!
Kobayakawa
Phew, I was panicking...
I'm the one who was panicking... Did you oversleep？
I stayed up late packing last night, just like you told me. Aren't you proud of me？
Yeah, sure. Doesn't do much good if you oversleep, though.
Come on, cut me some slack for the sake of this lovely May weather, okay？
Kobayakawa
Phew... That was way too close...
Didn't I tell you to pack before going to bed？
Now, now, girls have a lot going on. You know what they say about a woman's heart and the autumn sky, right？
Right... Wait, no, that has nothing to do with this.
Kobayakawa
Heheh! Come on, let's go! Off on our school trip!
Kobayakawa
Hey, we have to transfer somewhere, right？
Yeah, we take the Tobu limited express from Asakusa.
Got it. I see...
And once we're on the express, where to next？
We take it all the way to Kinugawa Onsen, right？
Huh？ What about Nikko, then？
No, we stay in Kinugawa tonight, and tomorrow—▲小早川＊▲... Wait, have you not looked at the itinerary at all？
Heh heh. I'm counting on you, ▼.
(Gotta keep this up...)
Whoa... So that's the Spacia express...
Ooh... Now this feels like a school trip. Looks like it could fly, doesn't it？
I doubt it flies, but it sure looks fast, huh？
Come on, let's get on! I get the window seat!
▲小早川＊▲, don't run!
Oh, right. ▲小早川＊▲, did you look at the tour itinerary？
Kobayakawa
Yes, sir! Haven't looked at it at all!
At least take a look at it...
Come on, that kind of stuff is where a guy gets to shine, right？ I'm gonna play the dutiful girl walking three steps behind. Counting on you, ▼.
(I don't think that's what that phrase means...)
Oh, the Spacia's already here!
Our school trip is finally getting started!
Ooh... Right before getting on an express train, I always get this sudden shiver.
Trembling with excitement？ I totally get it!
Hold on, go sit down first... Oh, and I called the window seat!
(Ah, the restroom... So much for three steps behind...)
Man... Spacious cars, big seats! You really can't beat an express train!
Kobayakawa
The Spacia really is amazing. I ended up buying coffee and potato chips at the snack car.
The snack car's great and all, but should you really be eating that stuff right now？
I'll be fine. More importantly, just so we're clear, this is a school trip. You get that, right？
Which means you and I are in the same grade, right？ You haven't forgotten that, have you？
So quit acting so bossy when we're in the same grade. Got it？
(And it's fine for the girl to act bossy, huh...)
Whoa... The scenery really changes once you get out this far...
Kobayakawa
▲小早川＊▲？
Kobayakawa
So how should we act like we're in the same grade？ Specifically, I mean.
We're still on that...？ I dunno... Maybe how we talk？
Right？ That's what I thought, so I was running simulations in my head, but...
It doesn't really seem any different from how I usually talk...
In your case, ▲小早川＊▲, yeah, probably not...
Should we just try changing our personas completely？ Like a couple from an old-school teen drama—a dashing guy and a sweet, cute girl.
(What happened to being in the same grade...？)
Kobayakawa
Hey, I have a little suggestion...
What's wrong？
I was thinking maybe I could do 'sweet, cute little Rinko' for you again. Come on... You liked it before, didn't you？
Oh, nice! By all means!
You got it... Wait, I mean...
...Yes, of course▼
(Looks like this time's gonna be a lot of fun too!)
Train Announcement
We will soon be arriving at Kinugawa Onsen. Please make sure you don't leave anything behind...
So this is Kinugawa Onsen... It's pretty modern, huh？
Kobayakawa
Yes... But just being together makes it romantic... Don't you think？
Whoa, hey... What's gotten into you？
Hold on, time out... I told you I was doing this! Now you be the charming guy!
Wait, you were serious...？ Alright then... Here goes.
You said it! Let's make lots of wonderful memories, ▲小早川＊▲!
Stop, stop. Uh... yeah, okay, I see how that turns out. Tell you what, hmm... Never mind, just act normal.
Hey...
Hey, what's that statue？ An ogre, maybe...? So cute▼ Shall we go look？
(She's really sticking with this, huh...)
Kobayakawa
We came back here together again, didn't we？ Kinugawa Onsen...
Yeah, another overnight stay in Kinugawa, huh？
Yes. We're together all day today... It still makes me a little nervous.
Don't worry! I won't try anything funny.
Okay... Though a little wouldn't hurt... Just kidding, never mind!
(Man, I really do like this... Doesn't feel much like a school trip, though.)
Here, I got the tickets.
Kobayakawa
Wow, thank you!
Y-Yeah... Anyway, let's head down to the dock by the riverbank.
The water's so clear... It's pretty...
Yeah, it really is... Wait, are you seriously sticking with that act？
What do you mean by "that"？
Oh, look! Those life jackets over there— going by size, would yours be 'Ages 4 to Grade School', ▲小早川＊▲？
Oh, stop it! You're such a meanie!
Oh, looks like boarding's started! Shall we go？
(Guess she's really serious about this...)
I got the tickets!
Kobayakawa
Thanks! Come on, let's head down to the river!
Aaah! The air's nice and cool. Feels so good...
Yeah... The current's pretty gentle around here, too.
Yes...
Little did the two of them know this would become a jungle cruise swarming with wild beasts... Heheh!
Haha!
Boatman
Thanks for waiting, folks! We're ready for boarding!
Oh, hurry! I wanna sit up near the front! Let's go!
Whoa... This is more thrilling than I expected...
Kobayakawa
Yeah, it's a little scary...
Boatman
Alright, water's coming! Please pull up your splash sheets!
What, no way！？ W-Wait a second!!
Come on, hurry!!
Waaah!!
And right here is Ghost Rock! Sure looks like a ghost, doesn't it？
Ahaha! Okay, that's a huge stretch! Besides, we had Gorilla Rock and Elephant Rock—it was a jungle theme up till now!
Hahaha! Hey, ▲小早川＊▲!
Hmm？
You broke character!
Boatman
Alright, please pull up your splash sheets!
Kobayakawa
Okay! Bring it on!
Whoa... We got splashed pretty good!
Yay! Rinko stayed nice and dry! Heheh!
Now, please look over there! See that rock sticking out？
Ooh, ooh! It's a gorilla!
Don't say it before he does!
Ahaha!
Kobayakawa
Hmm...
What's wrong？
Yeah, I've decided. I'm dropping it. The Showa popular-girl act is a no-go. Especially the lines.
That was fast... Well, just be yourself.
Right？ Still... playing the sweet, honest type was kind of fun.
Oh？
So... would it be okay if sweet, cute little Rinko stuck around a bit longer？
More than okay!
Heheh! Then... I'm gonna hold your hand♪
Oh, the bus is here!
Next we take the bus over to Tobu World Square!
Kobayakawa
Man, that was so much fun! Now that's entertainment, right？
The boatman's commentary really sells it, huh？
Exactly! Oh, right... Hey, can we hold hands？
Sure, go ahead.
Heheh♪ Even on the bus, the whole time, okay？
(Man, I really like this...)
Oh, the bus is here! Come on, let's go! Off to Tobu World Square!
Tobu World Square, huh...
Kobayakawa
You know, Rinko's actually been looking forward to this place a lot.
Oh yeah？ Really？
When I was little, I had tons of dolls and dollhouses, and I used to play with my mom all the time.
(She must mean her mother who passed away...)
She always dressed me up in frilly clothes, and my hair was super long... Hard to imagine now, huh？
Nothing wrong with that. Besides, you're sweet, cute ▲小早川＊▲ today, right？
Oh... Yeah. That's right.
Announcement
Next stop, Tobu World Square. Please make sure not to leave anything behind as you exit...
We're here. Tobu World Square, huh...
'An Encounter with Dreams and Wonder.' Talk about hype... Careful, or Rinko's gonna get her hopes up.
All right, let's head in!
Announcement
Next stop, Tobu World Square. Please make sure not to leave anything behind as you exit...
We're here! Where dreams and wonder meet: Tobu World Square...
Kobayakawa
Ahem... Fair warning: I'm about to turn into a total kid in here.
Okay？
I mean, I'm really gonna get carried away here.
Me too.
Heheh! Off we go!
Kobayakawa
Oooh...
Whoa, a 1/25-scale world, huh...
Oh, wow, hey, look! They even made tiny people! I'm so into this!▼
▲小早川＊▲, calm down!
Oh, over there! Come on, this way, this way!
Look, look! Even though everyone's tiny, they're walking around and doing their shopping!
Whoa, look at all the detail...
Hey there, pipsqueaks! I feel like a giant monster!
Hahaha!
Come on, take a picture! Rawwwr!!
All right！
Oh, this must be Europe, huh？
Kobayakawa
Yay! A trip around Europe in a flash!
▲小早川＊▲, don't run around so much you trip, okay？
Heheh! Oh, I found London's Buckingham Palace! And the Arc de Triomphe!
Even at 1/25 scale, it's pretty big, huh？ I bet I could crawl right under this!
Hey, you can't do that. Don't even try it, okay？
Ah, I get it! That's my cue to actually do it, right？ All right...
Whoa, hey, I said don't!
Just kidding! Ahaha!
You're really having a blast, ▲小早川＊▲...
Kobayakawa
Mmm~.
Is there something in particular you're looking for？
Yeah... Oh! That might be it!
Ahh... It really is wonderful. I could look at it forever...
Neuschwanstein Castle, huh. You're really fond of it, aren't you？
Yeah... I mean, it's the prettiest castle in the world, isn't it？
I bet right under this roof there's a grand hall, where they hold a ball every night...
When I was little, I used to play pretend balls with my mom all the time...
I'd wear a princess dress... A toy one, of course. And we'd put dresses on my dolls, too...
I see... That's a nice memory, huh？
It was fun... But...
It makes me feel a little lonely, though...
Man... Tobu World Square was great! Feels like we just went around the world!
Kobayakawa
Yeah. Say, did I get a little too carried away in there？
Maybe a little？
Hmm... Is it weird？ Should I just act normal？
No, it's nice for a change. It's a school trip, right？
I see.
Hehe...
Sweet, cute little Rinko does stuff like this too!
Y-yeah...
Come on, let's go. The bus comes soon, right？
Oh, right! Next up is Edo Wonderland Nikko Edomura!
Man... We really got into it again!
Kobayakawa
Hehe, I guess？ Miniatures just get me all excited for some reason.
You really like this stuff, huh, ▲小早川＊▲？
Yeah. That's part of it. Though...
On a school trip for two, I get to be sweet, cute little Rinko. Hehe...
Yeah... That's true, huh？
Um... Next up is...
Edo Wonderland Nikko Edomura!
Announcement
Now arriving at Edo Wonderland Nikko Edomura. Please make sure you have all your belongings...
Whoa... We're here. Edo Wonderland Nikko Edomura.
Kobayakawa
Edo Wonderland. It looks kind of like the gate to a temple, though-- Oh!
Some stern-looking official is staring right at us...
Y-yeah...
Gatekeeper
Honored guests, dost thou possess a travel pass？
Huh？ Um... What？ A travel pass？
Oh, I get it! Um, two adults, good sir!
...Right, all in order! Have a safe trip in there, good travelers!
Off we go, good sir!
I see. They really commit to it...
Ah, such a cynical attitude doth not become thee! Right？
Right, my bad. Uh... Verily, 'tis so!
Hehe! Come, let us venture forth!
Announcement
Now arriving at Edo Wonderland Nikko Edomura. Please make sure you have all your belongings...
Whoa... Edo Wonderland Nikko Edomura.
Kobayakawa
We have returned, good sir. Hey, the travel passes! Let me have 'em!
Here, two adults.
Hail, good officer!! Grant us entryyy!
H-hey, ▲小早川＊▲!
(All right, guess I'll get hyped up too!)
Hmm... It's pretty authentic here...
Kobayakawa
Since I'm a die-hard member of the Go-Home Club, I know my period dramas pretty well.
And this is amazing... Hm？ Look, an archery range! Grant us entry! Hallooo!
Whoa, hold up!
This time for sure... Hup!
Archery Attendant
Too baaad, a miss~!
Aaagh!! Come on, you missed!
Hey, this is pretty tough, okay？
Looks like you tensed up a little too much! Care to try, miss？
Leave it to me! Rinkonosuke will avenge you!
Just relax my shoulders... Hyah!
Bull's-eeeye~!
Yaaay! Verily, I scored a plushie~▼
(Not bad, ▲小早川＊▲...)
Hmm？ Something smells good.
Kobayakawa
Yeah... Rinkonosuke is famished.
Come to think of it, it's already past noon, huh？
A warrior cannot fight on an empty stomach! Make waaay!
H-Hey, wait up, Rinkonosuke!
Clerk
Welcome~!
Hmm...
Okay, eel kamameshi for me! Still haven't decided, ▲小早川＊▲？
Patience, my good man. ...Okay, I'll have the 'Ye Olde Curry Rice'!
All that time thinking, and you just get curry？
'Ye Olde Curry Rice,' verily. Rinkonosuke likes to play it safe with these things.
Most satisfying! That was a mighty fine 'Ye Olde Curry Rice'!
Thank you very much~!
That line is for... the 'Ninja Crow Mansion', huh？
Kobayakawa
'Ninja'？ Heheheh... This warrior is itching for a challenge.
Have at thee!
Hey... You're not serious, right？ Wait up, Lord Rinkonosuke!
Waaah!?
Whoa!? This is pretty intense...
Ugh...
What's wrong, Rinkonosuke？
N-Nothing! A ninja just jumped out from a weird spot, that's all...
Eeeek!
Man, that was some serious action in there, huh？
Pheeew...
Well, this warrior shall spare them for today...
(▲小早川＊▲ was pretty spooked in there...)
Kobayakawa
Oh, look over there. By that black wall.
'Ninja Trick Proverb Maze,' huh？ ...Sure you'll be okay？
Hmm？ Do not underestimate me... It's a race! See ya!
All right！
Huh？ 'Curse a man, dig two graves'... Didn't I just pass this one？
This is tough... Hey, ▲小早川＊▲~! How's it going over there？
Heheh! I'm right by the goal already~!
I can't lose now!
Made it! Huh, ▲小早川＊▲'s not here yet... Heeey, what happened？
Just a bit more！
She's taking a while...
▲小早川＊▲! Did you spot the hidden door？ You have to go through it!
Ugh, I know already!
Looks like she's stuck...
Hey! There's an exit halfway through, right？ Just come out through there!
No way! I'm coming over there!
Guess I'll go get her...
I came from that way, so next is... this way, right？ Heeey, Rinkonosuke...
Boo!!
Oh, there you are!
...Were you crying？
Not really...
Okay. Come on, let's head to the goal.
We're here! Go on, you go in first!
Yes...
What's wrong？
I was just thinking I kinda forgot to be 'honest Rinko' back there.
That's the part of you I really love▼
(That's... kinda embarrassing...)
Head Clerk
The Oiran Procession is starting! Ladies and gentlemen, please enjoy the courtesan's elegant parade!
Kobayakawa
That's lovely...
Okay...
Sigh... I'd love to try walking around like that... Even though I know it wouldn't suit me.
I wouldn't be so sure about that.
Yeah, right. You totally think I'd look like a little kid playing dress-up.
(A kid playing dress-up, huh... I can kinda see it...)
Hey... just now, I forgot again.
If I were an oiran, even if I looked like a kid in dress-up, would you still be my patron？
Of course I did.
Hehe... That makes me happy.
(Honest ▲小早川＊▲ is seriously cute...)
(All right, we've looked around all the souvenir shops... Huh, where's ▲小早川＊▲？)
Kobayakawa
Sorry for the wait. I bought a sword and a bunch of stuff. Plus... ta-da, look!
Phone straps？ Oh, there are names on them...
The one that says Rinko is yours, got it？ They're a matching set.
Huh. That's kinda unlike you, ▲小早川＊▲.
It's fine. That's just the kind of Rinko I'm being today.
Right... To commemorate 'honest Rinko' day, huh？
Yep, to commemorate it... Might as well say, 'Pretend it's me and take good care of it▼'
O-oh, sure. It's a little embarrassing, but I'll treasure it.
Phew... That was fun. Edo Wonderland Nikko Edomura. Feels like I still haven't had enough.
Yeah, let's come back again sometime.
Kobayakawa
Phew... This humble samurai sure had fun today...
Haha, you really cut loose today, huh, ▲小早川＊▲？
Hehe, I guess so! It's fine, though— today's special!
Because you're being 'honest Rinko' today, right？
Yep, and it's a school trip, after all.
That's right! And next up, it's finally time for the inn!
Don't say 'finally' like that! It makes me feel all shy... Idiot!
(Did she take that the wrong way or something...？)
Hm？ ▲小早川＊▲？
Kobayakawa
Asleep already...？ You did get pretty carried away back there...
I'm not asleep yet... What are we, a dad and his little kid？
Don't we have to transfer buses here？
Yeah. The bus for the hotel is... Oh, that must be it!
Driver
Sorry to keep you waiting! Guests staying at the Kinugawa Plaza Hotel!
We're here! So this is where we're staying, the Kinugawa Plaza Hotel!
Kobayakawa
Whoa! Pretty fancy... Wait, what's that thing？ ...A ball？
Sorry for the wait. I got us checked in. They said dinner's at 7.
Never mind that... Is this okay？ Isn't this place way too fancy？ Watch them charge us extra!
They wouldn't do that... I think...
Room Attendant
Thank you for waiting. I'll show you to your room. Miss, may I take your bag？
Oh, um, I'm fine! Thank you...
Certainly. Right this way, please.
Hmph... Guess I don't look like a wife, huh？ Whatever.
Come on! ▲小早川＊▲, let's go!
Driver
Sorry to keep you waiting! Guests staying at the Kinugawa Plaza Hotel!
We're here! Kinugawa Plaza Hotel!
Kobayakawa
Thanks for having us again! Hehe!
Sorry for the wait. We're all checked in. They said dinner's at 7.
At 7, right？ Okay! Oh, here comes the staff! Ahem!
Such a lovely hotel, isn't it, darling？
Eh？
Room Attendant
Thank you for waiting. I'll show you to your room. Ma'am, may I take your bag？
There it is!
Um... I'm fine, thank you. My husband will carry it.
What are you doing...？
Room Attendant
Please make yourself at home and have a relaxing stay.
Whoa!
Kobayakawa
It's huuuge... Wait, look at that! The TV is massive!
You're right. The decor is really classy, too... Hey, there's even a massage chair!
Okay, I'm starting to get a little scared here... This is okay, right？ It's free？
It should be fine... I think.
Alright! Whatever, let's just enjoy our fancy room!
Kobayakawa
Come on over. Allow Lady Rinko to pour you some tea.
Oh, thanks!
Still, this really is an amazing room... Great view of Kinugawa, too.
Plus, we've got our own open-air bath on the balcony.
I know, right! Not that I can actually use it, though.
Huh？ Why not？
Because you can see right into it from the room!
Yeah, but look, there's a paper screen you can close so you can't see—
Like I can trust you.
Ah, I see...
Hey, wanna hit the big public bath before dinner？
Kobayakawa
Oh, yeah, definitely! Hehe!
Alright, let's meet back here after, okay？
Okay! Don't stay in too long, alright？
Same goes for you, ▲小早川＊▲.
Girls are allowed to take their time! See you in a bit!
'Bath of Treasures', huh! Sounds pretty lucky!
Man, it's huge! A full view of Kinugawa! Feels amazing~!
(Phew... It's washing away all the day's fatigue... I'm getting sleepy...)
Alright, time to get out!
Whoa!! Was I dreaming!?
That was close... I really better get out...
Let's see, where's ▲小早川＊▲...？
Sorry to keep you waiting...
Whoa...
Quit staring so much...
What's wrong with that？ It looks great on you.
Really？ Heheh▼
Kobayakawa
Mmm... Massage chairs are great! I want one at my house too.
That good, huh？ Maybe I'll try it too？
You totally should. It's free, after all.
Room Attendant
Pardon the intrusion. I've brought your meal.
Oh, it's here!
I've been waiting for this!
Mmm~, delicious♪
Man, this is good!
It's a kaiseki meal, see？ Check out the menu.
Whoa, looks like there's still a lot more coming.
There's no way I can eat all this. Hmm... In that case... Alright!
You can have the sashimi, fish cake, and the hot pot, so give me all the dessert♪
What!? All of it？
Now, now. In return, I'll feed it right to you, okay？
Here, say ahh...
(I hate to admit it, but I'm pretty happy...)
Whew! I'm stuffed...
Kobayakawa
Me too... I can't eat another bite...
Wanna explore the hotel to help digest our food？
Hmm... Part of me just wants to lounge around, but... alright, let's go.
They've got a lot... Local specialties, Utsunomiya gyoza, regional snacks...
▲主人公＊▲。
Oh, ▲小早川＊▲, find anything good？
They have gyoza potato chips. Is that a local thing？
For Utsunomiya gyoza, maybe？ Are you gonna buy them？
I'll buy them, but I won't eat them now. You know... Out of courtesy, I guess？
Oh, I saw something like an arcade earlier. Let's go check it out!
Oh, nice, they even have pool! Wanna play a game？
Hmm, I'm kind of at a disadvantage when it comes to pool—
